name: londway-capital
description: A modern fintech banking platform combining the trust of traditional banks with the intelligence and design of next-generation finance apps.

scripts.build:all: npm run build:user && npm run build:admin
scripts.install:apps: npm install --legacy-peer-deps --prefix apps/user && npm install --legacy-peer-deps --prefix apps/admin
scripts.build:site: npm run install:apps && npm run build:user && npm run build:admin && node scripts/merge-static-site.js
